_comment: Propel nav fast-path config (Taskmaster #74). This is a SAMPLE / reference of the file the frontend fetches at GET ${REACT_APP_HEROES_BASE_URL || '/heroes'}/nav.config.json. Drop a copy (named exactly nav.config.json) on the SAME host-mounted heroes volume that serves the hero bundles, then hard-refresh the browser — NO engine rebuild. Prod mount: /data/coolify/services/<svc>/heroes/nav.config.json. Staging mount: ~/twenty-staging/heroes/nav.config.json. Each entry merges OVER the baked default (packages/twenty-front/src/modules/propel/runtime/propelNavConfig.ts DEFAULT_NAV_CONFIG) by `key` — so to just relabel Marketing you only need {"key":"marketing-hub","label":"Campaigns"}. `icon` is any Tabler icon name from twenty-ui/display (e.g. IconBroadcast). `enabled:false` hides the sidebar item but the route still resolves for deep-links. `route` is the AppPath path string. `bundle` is the runtime hero bundle name (heroes/<bundle>/index.js). If this file is absent/malformed the baked default is used and nothing regresses.
